Give now Every day, together with you, CARE saves lives and helps millions of people find the way to a better life worldwide. CARE is efficient. Your donation does more when you give it to CARE. 90% of the money CARE spends goes toward our lifesaving work that saves and transforms lives. CARE is far-reaching. We are one of the largest networks of humanitarians in the world, working in 118 countries. CARE is locally led. 98% of our staff are from the countries or regions where we work. This means we can respond as soon as emergencies happen, and we stay long after the TV cameras leave. CARE is trusted. With nearly 80 years of service, CARE has a history of building community trust. headings: Fighting hunger one family at a time.
Around 4,200 Arlington families weekly rely on AFAC groceries for their regular meals.
Your neighbor deserves to know where their next meal is coming from.

Skip to content Get Groceries/Conseguir Alimentos Donate Volunteer × Home About Our Mission Our People Latest News & Updates In the News Careers Financials Donate Funds Volunteer Become a Volunteer Our Needs Login Donate Food Food Donations Drop-Off Locations Register a Food Drive Food Drive Ideas Food Drive Toolkit Get Groceries Get Groceries Conseguir Alimentos Holiday Groceries Alimentos Festivos Events Events Hunger Action Month Connect Fighting hunger one family at a time. Providing dignified access to free groceries, allowing families to devote their limited financial resources to obligations such as housing, utilities, medication, and other basic needs. Donate Today Feed a Neighbor AFAC is 91% privately funded - every dollar you donate makes it possible for us to buy groceries for the many families who come to our doors weekly. Donate Funds Make an Impact AFAC volunteers donate over 51,000 hours of their time each year, the equivalent of 25 full-time employees. Come be a part of our mission. Volunteer Support our Community 30% of the food we distribute is donated by people like you through local food drives, providing families in need with variety and choice. Donate Food Around 4,200 Arlington families weekly rely on AFAC groceries for their regular meals. Supplemental groceries from AFAC mean that families can remain in their homes, workers can stay on the job, children are ready to learn, and mothers and babies receive essential nutrition. We help relieve the food budgets of our clients, allowing them to make other necessary purchases without sacrificing their health and nutrition needs. About Us Your neighbor deserves to know where their next meal is coming from. 199,820 trips to AFAC were made for groceries in FY 2025. Donate Funds 50+ volunteers support AFAC’s mission daily. Volunteer 32,000 pounds of donated food are distributed each week. Donate Food Neighbors helping neighbors. At times, feeding your family regular healthy meals can be challenging. AFAC is here to be your neighbor, providing a little help for when you need it. Donate Food Help us fight hunger together ! Subscribe to the newsletter to stay connected and informed.
